name: Web-CASA Lite
title: 精子活動力與運動軌跡
subtitle: Sperm Motility Analysis
description: 上傳顯微鏡影片，觀察精子候選追蹤軌跡與 CASA 速度參數。
description_en: Upload a microscopy video to visualize candidate sperm tracks and explore CASA motility and velocity parameters.

name: Web-CFU Lite
title: 菌落計數與 CFU/mL
subtitle: Colony Counting
description: 從培養皿照片辨識菌落，手動修正計數並練習稀釋換算。
description_en: Detect colonies in a plate photograph, correct annotations manually and practice dilution-based CFU/mL calculations.

name: Web-WBC Lite
title: 白血球分類判讀
subtitle: WBC Differential Training
description: 練習白血球形態辨識與 100-cell differential，查看教師標準答案與實驗性 AI 建議。
description_en: Learn leukocyte morphology, complete a 100-cell differential and compare student judgments with expert labels and experimental AI suggestions.

name: Web-AST Lite
title: 抗生素抑菌圈量測
subtitle: Disk Diffusion Analysis
description: 上傳 Kirby–Bauer 平板照片，估算抑菌圈直徑並進行人工修正。
description_en: Measure inhibition-zone diameters from Kirby–Bauer plate images and manually review disk and zone boundaries.

name: Web-Hemocytometer Lite
title: 血球計數盤與細胞濃度
subtitle: Neubauer Chamber Cell Counting
description: 上傳顯微鏡照片，自動圈選候選細胞並以觸控修正；練習 WBC、RBC、細胞培養計數、格線邊界及濃度換算。
description_en: Count cells in a Neubauer chamber image, edit candidate detections and calculate WBC, RBC or cell-culture concentrations.

name: Web-Trypan Blue
title: Trypan Blue 細胞存活率影像分析
subtitle: Live/Dead Cell Viability Analysis
description: 顯微鏡照片自動圈選活、死與待確認細胞，人工修正後計算存活率；支援 ROI、濃度換算與標記匯出。
description_en: Detect and manually review live, dead and uncertain cells in Trypan Blue microscopy images; calculate viability and export annotations.

name: Web-Image Lab
category: 鏡檢與影像分析 · Image Processing
title: ROI、灰階量測與顆粒計數
subtitle: Guided Microscopy Analysis · Local-only Measurements
description: 原創本機影像工具 v0.3：比例尺校正、12 顆合成基準圖、灰階差、ROI／粒子計數與 CSV 紀錄；另提供第三方 ImageJ.JS 外部連結。
description_en: Original local image analysis workspace for scale calibration, ROI statistics, grayscale comparison, particle counting and CSV export. A separate link leads to third-party ImageJ.JS.

name: Web-Gel · Gel Analyzer
category: 電泳與分子檢驗 · Gel Electrophoresis
title: DNA／蛋白質電泳影像與 Band 定量
subtitle: Gel Band Analysis · External Learning Tool
description: 前往 Tembrica Gel Analyzer（第三方網站）：上傳電泳照片、辨識 Lane／Band、選用 DNA／蛋白質 Ladder、查看強度分布並匯出分析結果。外部網站功能與使用條款由提供者管理。
description_en: External Tembrica Gel Analyzer: upload a gel image, detect lanes and bands, calibrate with DNA or protein ladders, and export analysis results. Subject to the external provider's terms.

name: Web-LFA · LFApp
category: 免疫分析與 POCT · Lateral Flow
title: 側向層析試紙 C／T 線訊號定量
subtitle: Lateral Flow Assay Quantification · External Research Tool
description: 前往 LFApp Mobile（第三方研究網站）：試紙照片 ROI、C／T 線強度、背景校正與校正曲線。原作者公開的 Shiny 服務目前無法由本站確認連線狀態；若無法載入，可查看專案使用指南。
description_en: External LFApp Mobile (R Shiny) for LFA image regions, control/test signal extraction, background correction and calibration. Its Shiny hosting availability has not been independently confirmed.
